name: test_discover
description: Discover changed-scope local test commands for legacy workflows; separate from parallel-plan verification.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository to discover verification commands in. Required — missing or unreadable repos surface as an infra_blocked result.

candidateCommit.description: Candidate commit to diff against for targeted discovery. Required when testMode is 'targeted' (the default); the result is invalid_input without it.

testMode.description: 'targeted' derives scope from the candidate's diff; 'full' runs the repository-wide suite and consults documented guides. Defaults to 'targeted'.

allowHeavySuites.description: Opts into heavy/expensive suites. Only takes effect when testMode is 'full'; ignored in targeted mode.

includeBrowserTests.description: Opts into browser/e2e test discovery when a suite is configured and provisioned. Only takes effect when testMode is 'full'; never triggers a browser binary install.

allowedWriteRoots.description: Declared write-scope override for a later repair step. Accepts an array of repository-relative path strings; wins over the scope discovery resolves.

verificationState.description: 'passed' when no tests are required, 'discovered' when a runnable plan was found, 'blocked' only for an invalid input or an infrastructure error.

executionOutcome.description: Fine-grained discovery outcome. Discovery never blocks: 'no_tests_required' (only documentation changed) and 'no_tests_found' (the repository has no test command) are passed outcomes; 'invalid_input' is a caller wiring defect (no candidate commit, a commit the repository does not have); 'infra_blocked' is an unexpected discovery error.

candidates.description: Discovered, validated verification commands. Empty when nothing ran.

items.description: One discovered command with its argv, source, scope, and coverage evidence.

reason.description: Why discovery ended where it did: empty for a discovered plan, the named reason for no_tests_required/no_tests_found, the message for invalid_input or an infrastructure error.

sourcePaths.description: Present on a successful discovery: guide/config files the candidates were derived from.

runtimeRequirements.description: Present on a successful discovery: detected runtime/tooling requirements (e.g. Java version) for the discovered commands.

changedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths changed by the candidate commit. Present on every discovery result; absent on an infra_blocked infrastructure error.

candidateCommit.description: Present on a successful discovery: the candidate commit discovery was run against.

mode.description: Present on a successful discovery: the resolved discovery mode.

selection.description: Present on a successful discovery: how commands were selected, e.g. changed-scope, documented-guide, build-system-inference, no-tests-required.

coverage.description: Present on a successful discovery: the coverage character of the discovered commands, e.g. focused, affected, repository, not-applicable.

affectedUnits.description: Present on a successful discovery: the build/test units the discovered commands affect.

repairRoots.description: Present on a successful discovery: write-scope roots derived from the discovered commands.

repairScopeResolved.description: Present on a successful discovery: whether repairRoots were resolved from real evidence.

rejectedCandidates.description: Present on a successful discovery: candidates considered but rejected, with their reason.

heavyAllowed.description: Present on a successful discovery: whether heavy suites were permitted for this discovery.

repairScope.description: The write scope a later repair step may use: allowedWriteRoots if given, else repairRoots discovery resolved.
